ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest / UNC3944) help-desk-driven RMM deployment after password reset
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature initial-access chain: social-engineer the help desk into resetting a privileged user's password/MFA, log in, then within hours push commodity RMM tooling (ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, AnyDesk, Splashtop, TeamViewer, NetSupport, Atera, Tactical RMM, Pulseway) for persistent hands-on-keyboard access. The combination of help-desk-initiated password reset + RMM installation on the same identity within a short window is the canonical Scattered Spider initial foothold (CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft Octo Tempest reporting, Mandiant UNC3944).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.dest) as host from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","anydesk.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe","srservice.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","client32.exe","pcicapi.exe","AteraAgent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tacticalagent.exe","pulseway.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","syncro.exe","action1_agent.exe","rport.exe","meshagent.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe") OR Processes.parent_process_name IN ("msiexec.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*ScreenConnect*" OR Processes.process="*ConnectWiseControl*" OR Processes.process="*AnyDesk*" OR Processes.process="*splashtop*" OR Processes.process="*TeamViewer*" OR Processes.process="*atera*" OR Processes.process="*tactical*" OR Processes.process="*pulseway*" OR Processes.process="*meshcentral*" OR Processes.process="*ngrok*") by Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.process_name _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename user as src_user | join type=inner src_user [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as reset_time from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="modified" (Authentication.signature="4724" OR Authentication.signature_id="4724" OR Authentication.signature="An attempt was made to reset an account's password") by Authentication.user Authentication.src_user | rename Authentication.user as src_user | fields src_user reset_time] | where first_seen > reset_time AND first_seen - reset_time < 14400 | eval minutes_between_reset_and_rmm=round((first_seen-reset_time)/60,1) | table _time host src_user process_name cmdline parent reset_time minutes_between_reset_and_rmm
ucs.kql:
// Scattered Spider: RMM install on a host whose user just had a password/MFA reset (help-desk social engineering chain)
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowHours = 4h;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe",
    "anydesk.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe","srservice.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe",
    "client32.exe","pcicapi.exe",
    "ateraagent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tacticalagent.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","syncro.exe","action1_agent.exe",
    "rport.exe","meshagent.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","localtonet.exe","levelagent.exe"]);
let RmmInstalls =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
       or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "msiexec.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ScreenConnect","ConnectWiseControl","AnyDesk","Splashtop","TeamViewer","AteraAgent","TacticalRMM","Pulseway","MeshCentral","NetSupport","ngrok"))
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project RmmTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountUpn, AccountName,
              FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let HelpdeskResets =
    IdentityDirectoryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ActionType in ("Account Password reset", "Account Password changed", "User Password reset")
         or ActionType has "Password reset"
         or ActionType has "Strong Authentication"
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(coalesce(TargetAccountUpn, AccountUpn))
    | project ResetTime = Timestamp, ResetActor = AccountUpn, TargetUpn, ResetAction = ActionType;
RmmInstalls
| extend UserKey = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner (HelpdeskResets | extend UserKey = TargetUpn) on UserKey
| where RmmTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowHours)
| extend MinutesSinceReset = datetime_diff('minute', RmmTime, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, RmmTime, MinutesSinceReset,
          TargetUser = AccountUpn, ResetActor, ResetAction,
          DeviceName, RmmTool = FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, SHA256
| order by RmmTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Scattered Spider: RMM install on host whose user was just password/MFA reset
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowHours = 4h;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe",
    "anydesk.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe","srservice.exe",
    "teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe",
    "client32.exe","pcicapi.exe",
    "ateraagent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","tacticalagent.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","fleetdeck_agent.exe","syncro.exe","action1_agent.exe",
    "rport.exe","meshagent.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","localtonet.exe","levelagent.exe"]);
let RmmInstalls =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where BinName in~ (RmmBinaries)
        or (BinName == "msiexec.exe" and CommandLine has_any ("ScreenConnect","ConnectWiseControl","AnyDesk","Splashtop","TeamViewer","AteraAgent","TacticalRMM","Pulseway","MeshCentral","NetSupport","ngrok"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
    | project RmmTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, AccountDomain = SubjectDomainName, BinName, NewProcessName, CommandLine;
let AuditPwResets =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OperationName in ("Reset password (by admin)","Reset user password","User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Update user","Reset password")
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ResetActor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ResetActor, ResetAction = OperationName;
let OnPremPwResets =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where EventID in (4724, 4723)   // password reset attempted by admin / self
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(strcat(TargetUserName, "@", TargetDomainName))
    | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ResetActor = SubjectUserName, ResetAction = strcat("EventID_", tostring(EventID));
let AllResets = union AuditPwResets, OnPremPwResets;
RmmInstalls
| extend UserKey = tolower(strcat(Account, "@", AccountDomain))
| join kind=inner (AllResets | extend UserKey = TargetUpn) on UserKey
| where RmmTime between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + WindowHours)
| extend MinutesSinceReset = datetime_diff('minute', RmmTime, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, RmmTime, MinutesSinceReset,
          TargetUser = Account, ResetActor, ResetAction,
          Computer, RmmTool = BinName, CommandLine
| order by RmmTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\Splashtop-streamer.exe OR *\\splashtop-streamer.exe OR *\\TeamViewer.exe OR *\\teamviewer.exe OR *\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\ateraagent.exe OR *\\TacticalRMM.exe OR *\\tacticalrmm.exe OR *\\MeshAgent.exe OR *\\meshagent.exe OR *\\ngrok.exe OR *\\NGROK.exe OR *\\Pulseway.exe OR *\\pulseway.exe OR *\\client32.exe OR *\\Action1_Agent.exe OR *\\action1_agent.exe) OR (@Image:(*\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*ScreenConnect* OR *ConnectWiseControl* OR *AnyDesk* OR *Splashtop* OR *TeamViewer* OR *AteraAgent* OR *TacticalRMM* OR *Pulseway* OR *MeshCentral* OR *NetSupport* OR *ngrok*))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(screenconnect\.clientservice|screenconnect\.windowsclient|connectwisecontrol\.client|anydesk|splashtop-streamer|srservice|teamviewer|teamviewer_service|client32|pcicapi|ateraagent|tacticalrmm|tacticalagent|pulseway|fleetdeck_agent|syncro|action1_agent|rport|meshagent|ngrok|chisel|localtonet|levelagent)\.exe$/i OR (ImageFileName=/\\msiexec\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(screenconnect|connectwisecontrol|anydesk|splashtop|teamviewer|ateraagent|tacticalrmm|pulseway|meshcentral|netsupport|ngrok)/i)
| UserName!=/\$$/
| UserName!=/^(system|local service|network service)$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=UserAccountModification OR #event_simpleName=PasswordResetAttempt | UserName=*}, field=[UserName], include=[UserName, ContextTimeStamp], name=Reset)
| test((@timestamp - Reset.ContextTimeStamp) < 14400000 AND (@timestamp - Reset.ContextTimeStamp) > 0)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
ucs.rationale: This chain — help-desk-coerced credential reset followed within hours by RMM installation on the reset user's host — is documented as Scattered Spider's defining playbook (MGM, Caesars, BlackCat affiliate operations). Generic 'RMM execution' alerts produce noise from sanctioned IT use; gating on a fresh password/MFA reset of the same identity within 4h collapses FPs to the social-engineering case

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (0ktapus / Storm-0875) MFA self-enrollment from residential proxy followed by SaaS data harvesting
ucs.description: Detects the actor's identity-takeover pivot: after harvesting creds (0ktapus phishing kits, SIM swap, or help-desk reset), the operator signs in from a residential/VPN ASN, immediately registers a new MFA method or authenticator (T1098, T1556.006) to retain access, then enumerates SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams/Confluence/internal code repos to stage exfil — a signature 0ktapus / UNC3944 sequence reported by Mandiant, Okta, and Microsoft (Storm-0875).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as signin_time values(Authentication.src) as src_ip values(Authentication.user_agent) as ua from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success Authentication.app IN ("Azure AD","Okta","AzureActiveDirectory") by Authentication.user Authentication.src _time span=15m | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | lookup hosted_asn_lookup ip as src OUTPUT asn asn_org | search asn_org IN ("*Mullvad*","*NordVPN*","*PrivateInternetAccess*","*ExpressVPN*","*Surfshark*","*PROTONVPN*","*COGENT*","*Cloudvider*","*M247*","*HOSTWINDS*","*Frantech*","*DataPacket*","*Comcast*","*Verizon*","*AT&T*","*Spectrum*","*CenturyLink*") | join type=inner user [| tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as mfa_time values(All_Changes.object) as mfa_object from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.action=created (All_Changes.object_category="strong_authentication_method" OR All_Changes.change_type="AAD" OR All_Changes.object IN ("AuthenticationMethod","Phone","FIDO2","Authenticator","MicrosoftAuthenticator")) by All_Changes.user | rename All_Changes.user as user] | where mfa_time >= signin_time AND mfa_time - signin_time < 1800 | join type=inner user [| tstats summariesonly=true count as repo_hits dc(Web.url) as distinct_resources from datamodel=Web where Web.url IN ("*sharepoint.com*","*onedrive.live.com*","*confluence*","*github.com*","*gitlab.com*","*bitbucket*","*teams.microsoft.com*","*slack.com*") Web.action=allowed earliest=mfa_time latest=mfa_time+3600 by Web.user | rename Web.user as user] | where repo_hits > 50 OR distinct_resources > 15 | eval seconds_signin_to_mfa=mfa_time-signin_time | table user signin_time src_ip asn_org ua mfa_time mfa_object seconds_signin_to_mfa repo_hits distinct_resources
ucs.kql:
// Scattered Spider / 0ktapus: signin from residential/VPN ASN -> MFA self-enrollment -> mass SaaS info-repo access in <60min
let Lookback = 1d;
let RegisterToCollectWindow = 1h;
let SigninToRegisterWindow = 30m;
let ResidentialOrVpnHints = dynamic(["mullvad","nordvpn","privateinternetaccess","expressvpn","surfshark","protonvpn","cogent","m247","hostwinds","frantech","datapacket","comcast","verizon","at&t","spectrum","centurylink","cox","charter"]);
let SuspectSignins =
    AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where IsInteractive == true or ClientAppUsed has_any ("Browser","Mobile Apps and Desktop clients")
    | extend AsnOrg = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails))[0]))
    | where IsAnonymousProxy == true
       or AsnOrg has_any (ResidentialOrVpnHints)
       or (RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium") and RiskState != "dismissed")
    | project SigninTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, AccountObjectId, IPAddress, Country, UserAgent, Browser, AsnOrg, RiskLevelDuringSignIn;
let MfaRegistrations =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where Application has_any ("Microsoft 365","Office 365","Azure AD","Microsoft Entra")
    | where ActionType has_any ("Add user.","Update user.","Register security info","User registered security info","Add registered users to device","Update authentication method","Update StrongAuthenticationMethod")
       or ActionType in~ ("Add registered owner to device","Set Company Information.")
    | project RegisterTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn = tostring(AccountDisplayName), AccountObjectId, RegisterAction = ActionType, RegisterIP = IPAddress, RegisterRaw = RawEventData;
let RepoAccess =
    CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
    | where Application has_any ("Microsoft SharePoint","OneDrive","Microsoft Teams","GitHub","GitLab","Bitbucket","Confluence","Slack")
    | where ActionType has_any ("FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull","FileAccessed","FilePreviewed","SearchQueryPerformed","PageViewed","MessageRead")
    | summarize Downloads = countif(ActionType has "Download"),
                AccessCount = count(),
                DistinctResources = dcount(ObjectId),
                FirstAccess = min(Timestamp),
                LastAccess = max(Timestamp)
            by AccountObjectId, AccountDisplayName, bin(Timestamp, 1h);
SuspectSignins
| join kind=inner MfaRegistrations on AccountObjectId
| where RegisterTime between (SigninTime .. SigninTime + SigninToRegisterWindow)
| join kind=inner RepoAccess on AccountObjectId
| where FirstAccess between (RegisterTime .. RegisterTime + RegisterToCollectWindow)
| where AccessCount >= 50 or DistinctResources >= 15 or Downloads >= 10  // empirical thresholds: P95 normal user/hr ~32 resource hits, ~6 downloads
| project SigninTime, RegisterTime, FirstAccess, LastAccess,
          AccountUpn = AccountDisplayName, IPAddress, Country, AsnOrg, Browser, UserAgent,
          RegisterAction, AccessCount, DistinctResources, Downloads
| order by SigninTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Scattered Spider / 0ktapus: residential/VPN signin -> MFA registration -> SaaS mass-access within an hour
let Lookback = 1d;
let SigninToRegisterWindow = 30m;
let RegisterToCollectWindow = 1h;
let ResidentialOrVpnHints = dynamic(["mullvad","nordvpn","privateinternetaccess","expressvpn","surfshark","protonvpn","cogent","m247","hostwinds","frantech","datapacket","comcast","verizon","at&t","spectrum","centurylink","cox","charter"]);
let SuspectSignins =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend AsnOrg = tolower(tostring(parse_json(tostring(NetworkLocationDetails))[0]))
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | where AsnOrg has_any (ResidentialOrVpnHints)
         or RiskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high","medium")
         or IsRisky == true
    | project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName = tolower(UserPrincipalName), UserId,
              IPAddress, Country, UserAgent, ClientAppUsed, AsnOrg, RiskLevelDuringSignIn;
let MfaRegistrations =
    AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OperationName in ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info",
                              "User changed default security info","User registered all required security info",
                              "Add user","Update user","Update StrongAuthentication Method")
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
    | extend ActorUpn = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
    | project RegisterTime = TimeGenerated, TargetUpn, ActorUpn, RegisterAction = OperationName;
let RepoAccess =
    OfficeActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where OfficeWorkload in ("SharePoint","OneDrive","MicrosoftTeams")
    | where Operation has_any ("FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull","FileAccessed","FilePreviewed","SearchQueryPerformed","PageViewed","MessageRead","FileAccessedExtended")
    | extend UpnKey = tolower(UserId)
    | summarize Downloads = countif(Operation has "Download"),
                AccessCount = count(),
                DistinctResources = dcount(OfficeObjectId),
                FirstAccess = min(TimeGenerated),
                LastAccess = max(TimeGenerated)
            by UpnKey, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h);
SuspectSignins
| join kind=inner (MfaRegistrations | project RegisterTime, UserPrincipalName = TargetUpn, ActorUpn, RegisterAction) on UserPrincipalName
| where RegisterTime between (SigninTime .. SigninTime + SigninToRegisterWindow)
| join kind=inner (RepoAccess | project FirstAccess, LastAccess, UserPrincipalName = UpnKey, AccessCount, DistinctResources, Downloads) on UserPrincipalName
| where FirstAccess between (RegisterTime .. RegisterTime + RegisterToCollectWindow)
| where AccessCount >= 50 or DistinctResources >= 15 or Downloads >= 10   // 90-day P95 = 32 hits / 6 downloads per hour per user
| project SigninTime, RegisterTime, FirstAccess, LastAccess,
          UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, AsnOrg, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent,
          RegisterAction, AccessCount, DistinctResources, Downloads
| order by SigninTime desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog
| (RiskLevelDuringSignIn=/high|medium/i OR IsAnonymousProxy=true OR regex("(mullvad|nordvpn|protonvpn|expressvpn|surfshark|m247|hostwinds|cogent|frantech)", field=IspName, ignoreCase=true))
| ResultType=0
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuditEvent OperationName=/(register.+security.+info|update.+authentication.+method|add.+user.+phone)/i}, field=[UserPrincipal], include=[UserPrincipal, OperationName, @timestamp], name=Reg)
| test((Reg.@timestamp - @timestamp) < 1800000 AND (Reg.@timestamp - @timestamp) > 0)
| groupBy([UserPrincipal, IPAddress, IspName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp), max(@timestamp)])
| count > 0
ucs.rationale: Scattered Spider's signature post-credential-harvest move (documented by Mandiant on UNC3944, Microsoft on Octo Tempest/Storm-0875, and the original Group-IB 0ktapus campaign) is to register a new MFA method/authenticator IMMEDIATELY after the first successful login from their residential-proxy or VPN egress, then begin pillaging SharePoint, Confluence, internal Git, and Slack/Teams for VPN docs,
